boot.savesUnavailable.title: Saves unavailable
boot.savesUnavailable.body: This browser has no local storage this game can reach.
boot.notFound.title: No such screen
boot.unknownMission.title: Mission not found
boot.unknownMission.body: This link points at a mission that does not exist in this build.
boot.savesUnavailable.next: Saves need site data. Allow this site to store data in your browser settings (a private window often blocks it), then reload.
boot.notFound.next: The link may be mistyped or out of date. Go back to the main menu to carry on.
boot.unknownMission.next: The link may be from an older version of the game. Pick a mission from the campaign map instead.
boot.failed.graphics.title: This browser cannot draw the battlefield
boot.failed.graphics.body: The battlefield needs hardware-accelerated 3D graphics, and this browser did not provide them. Hardware acceleration may be switched off, or the browser may be too old.
boot.failed.graphics.next: Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings and restart the browser, or open the game in a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. Your campaign is kept on this device.
boot.failed.download.title: Part of the game did not download
boot.failed.download.body: A file this screen needs could not be loaded, so it cannot start.
boot.failed.download.next: Check your connection, then reload. Your campaign is kept on this device and is not affected.
boot.failed.unknown.title: Something went wrong
boot.failed.unknown.body: The game hit a problem it did not expect and could not open this screen.
boot.failed.unknown.next: Reload to try again. Your campaign is kept on this device and is not affected.
boot.failed.interrupted.title: The picture stopped
boot.failed.interrupted.body: The browser took the game's graphics away, which can happen when the graphics card resets or the computer runs short of memory. The battle is on hold and cannot be drawn.
boot.failed.interrupted.next: Reload to start this mission again. This attempt is lost, and your campaign is kept on this device.
smallScreen.title: Best on a larger screen
smallScreen.body: Roaring Lions is played with a mouse on a wide screen. Held upright, a phone cannot fit the command strip or the feed.
smallScreen.next: Rotate your device, or open the game on a computer. You can carry on here, but part of the screen stays cut off.

settings.fullscreen.refused: Fullscreen was refused by the browser.
settings.quality.hint: High: everything, 4K shadows. Medium: anti-aliasing, 2K shadows. Low: no ambient occlusion, no anti-aliasing, soft shadows. Applies when the next mission starts.

settings.language.hint: More languages are coming. A change takes effect after a reload.

hud.pinned.label: Pinned
hud.pinned.explain: Pinned — suppressed past the limit, holding fire and barely moving. Lifts a few seconds after the fire stops landing nearby: the shooter dies, stops, or loses sight (smoke works too). Cover cuts how much suppression reaches you in the first place. Infantry pinned continuously for about 10 seconds breaks and routs; vehicles hold as long as it takes.
hud.strip.broken.tip: Broken — routed and fleeing the fight. They rally once clear of it.
